newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish warned rats urinate on beer bottles.
newsitem.headline: Irish warned rats urinate on beer bottles.

text.p: If you drink beer straight from the bottle, Ireland's Southern Health Board has a couple of words of warning for you: Rats Urine.
The board issued a statement on Friday warning drinkers to be aware of Weil's disease or Leptospirosis, which starts with symtoms akin to infuenza but can kill.
It said the disease is spread mainly by rats' urine and warned that crates of beer stacked in Irish pubs could be a target for the rodents.
Ireland, like many European countries, has seen a boom in sales of bottled beers, mainly American brews which are drunk "by the neck" as an alternative to the traditional pint glass.
